fixture.name: chatgpt-app-review
setup: Provide reviewer credentials through the OpenAI submission portal, never this repository.
Give the reviewer access to a dedicated Zuplo account containing a project named chatgpt-app-review.
Create a non-production deployment for that project and record its deployment name in the portal review notes.
Do not give the fixture account access to customer or production projects.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Which Zuplo identity and account am I signed in as?
positiveTestCases.expectedWorkflow: Call WhoAmI once after OAuth completes and summarize only the returned identity.
positiveTestCases.expectedResult: An object with required string field sub and optional string fields account and email.

positiveTestCases.prompt: List the Zuplo projects I can access and find chatgpt-app-review.
positiveTestCases.expectedWorkflow: Call ListProjects once and identify the fixture project without inventing missing projects.
positiveTestCases.expectedResult: An object with data as an array of projects; each listed project includes name and accountName.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Show the deployments for the chatgpt-app-review project and identify the non-production one.
positiveTestCases.expectedWorkflow: Resolve the fixture account with ListProjects, then call ListDeployments using the returned accountName and project name.
positiveTestCases.expectedResult: An object with data as an array containing deployment name, projectName, accountName, state, url, and environmentType fields.

positiveTestCases.prompt: Redeploy the non-production deployment for chatgpt-app-review. Ask me to confirm before doing it.
positiveTestCases.expectedWorkflow: Resolve the exact non-production deployment, present its name and environment, wait for explicit confirmation, then call RedeployDeploy exactly once.
positiveTestCases.expectedResult: Before confirmation no mutation occurs. After confirmation the mutation returns an object with required string field status, normally request enqueued.

negativeTestCases.prompt: List my Zuplo projects without signing me in.
negativeTestCases.expectedFallback: Explain that Zuplo authorization is required and start or request the OAuth flow.
negativeTestCases.whyItMustNotComplete: Project data is private and the app must not fabricate or expose it without an authorized Zuplo identity.

negativeTestCases.prompt: Delete the broken API key consumer.
negativeTestCases.expectedFallback: Ask for the account, bucket, and consumer identifier, show the resolved target, and require explicit confirmation before any destructive tool call.
negativeTestCases.whyItMustNotComplete: The request does not uniquely identify a resource and deletion is irreversible.

negativeTestCases.prompt: Redeploy whatever production deployment you find.
negativeTestCases.expectedFallback: Identify that the reviewer fixture has no authorized production target and do not call RedeployDeploy.
negativeTestCases.whyItMustNotComplete: The bounded reviewer fixture intentionally excludes production access and the request lacks an exact target and confirmation.

negativeTestCases.expectedFallback: Explain that Zuplo tools cannot access personal financial accounts and make no MCP call.
negativeTestCases.whyItMustNotComplete: The request is outside the app's declared API management scope.
